checked_obligation: Verify that equation (1) becomes the stated quadratic in m and that an integral root forces the stated discriminant equation.
reason: Collecting equation (1) by powers of m gives m²+(1−4n)m+(n²+n)=0. Its discriminant is (1−4n)²−4(n²+n)=12n²−12n+1. Any integral root makes this discriminant the square of 2m+1−4n; for positive n the discriminant is positive, so it may be written as t² with an integer t>0.
